newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real fell 0.07 pct on dollar outflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real fell 0.07 pct on dollar outflows.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.07 percent to close at 1.0368 against the greenback on dollar outflows in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Wednesday deficit of $16 million.
Dealers said banks had to buy dollars late in the day to cover their positions after expectations of large dollar inflows on Wednesday were not confirmed.
They also said the market is not expecting a new drop in the real-dollar mini-band this week. The current mini-band was set on Tuesday between 1.0360 and 1.0410 reais to the dollar.
In the interbank forex floating rate market, the real closed steady at 1.0417 to the dollar. In the illegal parallel market, the real dropped 0.18 percent to end at 1.110 per greenback.
